reason: The hypothesis directly restates the central finding of P24 and P7/P15 that edge dislocations control plasticity in BCC refractory HEAs, applies it to the specific alloy WTaTiVZr (which is a minor variant of alloys already studied in P1, P4, P9), and contrasts it with the known screw-dislocation behavior of pure tungsten. The mechanism, predicted outcomes, and experimental approach are all taken from these passages without combining them into a new synthesis or resolving any conflict.
